name: Amnon
summary: David's firstborn feigned sickness to get his half-sister alone, and when she pleaded that such a thing should not be done in Israel, forced her, then hated her more than he had loved her and had her thrown out. David was very wroth and did nothing.
offense: Incest and rape together, both capital under the law he was heir to. Tamar had named the law and offered him the lawful way of asking the king; he would not hearken to her voice. Then he added public shame to the crime.
judgment: Two years later Absalom had him killed at the sheep-shearing feast when his heart was merry with wine. Nathan's sentence on David's house, the sword shall never depart, began its work here.
